Author: Kathy Auteberry (fork of AnoMech by Anomek)
Name: FluffySim
Description: Practice FFXIV Ultimate mechanics inside the game, solo with seven simulated party members or together in multiplayer. Covers Dragonsong's Reprise (Elemental) and Futures Rewritten (Mana), plus The Epic of Alexander (Mana), The Omega Protocol P1–P4 (Elemental) and Dancing Mad (Mana) in beta, with God Mode, Pause and Restart for repeated attempts. Based on AnoMech by Anomek and contributors.
Punchline: Ultimate practice for DSR, FRU, TEA, TOP and Dancing Mad, solo or multiplayer.
Changelog:
Added
- Dancing Mad P2: Trine: (Mana "Yan", beta).
- The Omega Protocol P4: Blue Screen: (Elemental, beta).

Changed
- No headgear on the party: Simulated party members no longer wear hats, so each seat's hair and ears stay visible.

Fixed
- Forsaken matches retail: Dancing Mad P2 Forsaken is now checked against ten retail pulls; its tower, debuff and End timings already matched.
- Oversampled Wave Cannon positions: In TOP P3, the bot positions now follow four retail pulls instead of the guide's diagram.

Known issues
- Trine: retail showed a different burst pattern in each of three pulls, so which triangles burst in which wave is random.

Author: Kathy Auteberry (fork of EchoXIV by ssalazar217)
Name: Kotodama
Description:
Kotodama is a personal fork of EchoXIV focused on fast, accurate Japanese<->English chat translation for Japanese PF raiding and everyday social chat, powered by a local LLM.

Based on EchoXIV by ssalazar217: https://github.com/ssalazar217/EchoXIV
Punchline: Japanese<->English chat translation with a local LLM. Fork of EchoXIV.
Changelog:
Incoming messages
- Lines you type yourself (without /tl) are never translated, so a Japanese line of your own no longer gets a [KT] translation.
- Your own lines in party chat are now recognised too (the party number in front of your name used to hide them).
